title: B2B Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist
company: Thomas Lee Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Engineering Products Data-Driven Marketing International Markets

Location: Shrewsbury, Shropshire

Salary: £37,000 per annum

Job Type: Full-time, Maternity Cover

Future Opportunity: Potential for a permanent position

The Opportunity

We're recruiting for an established engineering products business looking for a commercially minded B2 B marketing professional to support its UK and international sales operations.

This isn't simply a role creating social media posts, writing newsletters or maintaining a website.

We're looking for someone who can take information, understand the market, develop targeted marketing strategies and, importantly, turn that activity into genuine sales opportunities.

Working closely with the sales team, you'll use customer data, market research, digital marketing, AI and modern marketing technology to identify potential customers, build campaigns and generate qualified leads.

This is a hands-on, varied position within an SME engineering environment, where you'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table and see the commercial impact of your work.

What You'll Be Doing

Marketing Strategy & Data Analysis
- Analyse existing customer, prospect and marketing data to identify trends and opportunities.
- Research new markets, industries and potential customers across the UK and internationally.
- Develop practical marketing strategies to support commercial growth.
- Identify target customer groups and build focused marketing campaigns.
- Use campaign performance data to continually improve results.

Lead Generation & Sales Support
- Develop and execute campaigns designed to generate qualified sales enquiries.
- Identify potential customers and commercially relevant opportunities.
- Work closely with the sales team to understand their requirements.
- Provide sales colleagues with useful prospect information and actionable leads.
- Track lead generation, engagement and campaign effectiveness.

Digital Marketing & Content
- Plan and deliver B2 B email marketing campaigns.
- Create relevant content for websites, digital channels and marketing communications.
- Support SEO, online visibility and product marketing activities.
- Communicate the benefits of specialist engineering products to different customer audiences.
- Maintain consistent and professional marketing communications.

AI & Marketing Technology
- Use AI tools to support market research, data analysis, content development and campaign planning.
- Make effective use of CRM, marketing automation and digital marketing platforms.
- Explore ways to improve marketing efficiency through technology.
- Research and adopt suitable new tools where they add genuine commercial value.
- Ensure marketing information is accurate, relevant and handled appropriately.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in speaking with marketing professionals who enjoy combining analytical thinking with practical campaign delivery.

You might currently be working as a Marketing Executive, Senior Marketing Executive, B2 B Marketing Specialist or within a similar commercially focused marketing position.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in B2 B marketing.
- Experience developing and delivering marketing campaigns.
- An understanding of lead generation and how marketing supports sales.
- Confidence analysing data and identifying commercial opportunities.
- Experience using CRM systems and digital marketing tools.
- An interest in AI and how it can improve marketing research and productivity.
- Good communication, organisation and content development skills.
- The ability to work independently and manage different marketing activities.
- A commercially minded approach with a focus on measurable results.

Experience within engineering, manufacturing, industrial products or technical distribution would be advantageous, although we're equally interested in candidates from other B2 B environments with transferable experience.

You don't need to be an expert in every marketing platform. We're more interested in someone who understands how to use information, technology and marketing techniques to achieve results.

What's on Offer?
- £37,000 annual salary.
- A varied, hands-on marketing position.
- Exposure to UK and international engineering markets.
- The opportunity to use AI and modern marketing technology.
- Close involvement with sales and business development.
- A chance to contribute ideas and influence marketing activity.
- Potential for permanent employment following the maternity-cover period, depending on business requirements.

The Right Person

We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding markets, developing ideas and putting them into practice.

Someone who doesn't just measure success by how many emails are sent or how many posts are published, but by whether their marketing activity generates useful opportunities for the business.

If you have a background in B2 B marketing, enjoy using data and technology, and want a position where your work has a direct commercial impact, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

About Us

At Thomas Lee Recruitment, we specialise in connecting engineers and technical salespeople with leading companies in the engineering sector. We pride ourselves on offering a personalised, professional, and transparent recruitment service. Our focus is on understanding both client and candidate needs to ensure the best possible match.

How to Apply

All applications will be responded to. Please ensure you have the right to work in the UK before applying.

By applying for this role, you accept our Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, and Disclaimers, which can be found on our website.

title: Brand Manager
description:
Brand Manager - Health

Market Drayton

Monday - Friday

Müller is growing its presence within health and nutrition, creating new opportunities to reach consumers and expand into developing areas of the market.

We're looking for a Brand Manager - Health to join our award-winning Marketing Team and help shape the next stage of that growth. You'll have the opportunity to work across brand strategy, innovation and activation, helping create new products and bring compelling campaigns to life.

This is a varied Brand Manager role covering the full marketing mix, including innovation, communications, digital, PR, packaging, shopper marketing and in-store activation. You'll work on some of the nation's most recognised dairy brands, alongside newer partnerships and propositions such as Müller x Myprotein.

Your challenge

You'll take responsibility for areas of the Müller health portfolio, helping develop the brand plans and innovation needed to unlock further growth.

Depending on your background, your strengths may sit within brand development and strategy, or you may have broader experience launching products and delivering effective activation. What matters is your ability to understand consumers, make commercially grounded recommendations and turn plans into results.

You'll work closely with Sales, Category, Commercial, R&D and agency partners, bringing different teams together to develop products, secure distribution and deliver impactful campaigns.

Key responsibilities
- Support the development and delivery of brand strategies and annual brand plans.
- Lead new product development from initial idea through to launch and in-market activation.
- Plan and execute activity across media, communications, shopper and commercial channels.
- Act as a key day-to-day contact for creative and media agencies, with support from the Senior Brand Manager.
- Take responsibility for areas of the health portfolio, including brand planning, innovation development and commercial performance.
- Work with Sales and Category teams to understand performance and identify distribution and growth opportunities.
- Use brand, consumer and commercial data to make clear recommendations.
- Track brand and campaign performance against agreed measures and identify where activity needs to be adjusted.
- Coordinate cross-functional project teams and manage multiple priorities.
- Manage and develop one direct report.

About you

You'll have consumer marketing experience, ideally gained in FMCG, food, drink, nutrition, health and wellness or another fast-paced branded environment.

We're looking for someone who can bring a combination of:
- Brand strategy and practical in-market execution.
- New product development or innovation experience.
- Campaign, media, communications or brand activation experience.
- Commercial awareness and an understanding of how marketing decisions affect wider business performance.
- Confidence using data and insight to inform brand recommendations.
- Strong project management and organisational skills.
- The ability to influence stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams.
- A collaborative, pragmatic approach and the confidence to take ownership.

You don't need to be a specialist in every area. You might be particularly strong in brand positioning and innovation, or you might have deeper experience in activation, communications and driving brand growth in market.

Benefits:
- Annual bonus of up to 10%
- Annual pay reviews
- Private healthcare cover
- 4 x life assurance
- Pension plan - up to 8% matched contribution
- 25 days annual leave - increasing with service - plus bank holidays
- Purchase/sell annual leave scheme
- Enhanced maternity/paternity/family leave policy
- Employee assistance programme
- In addition, our employees have access to a Rewards Benefits Programme, giving you a range of discounts across 800 retailers online and in store

If you're ready to take real ownership, work across the full marketing mix and help develop Müller's growing health portfolio, we'd like to hear from you.

You can find out more about Müller and what it's like to work for us by clicking here Careers at Müller UK & Ireland

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Executive
description:
Digital Marketing & Growth Executive

Up to £37,500: Shrewsbury: Maternity Cover: Immediate Start: Office Based

As Digital Marketing & Growth Executive, you're the person who watches an advert and immediately starts thinking about who else it could reach.

A different audience.
Another industry.
A market nobody's really thought about targeting yet.

You don't just understand how Meta advertising works, ou understand why people respond to it, what makes them click and, more importantly, what makes them become a customer.

And you've probably got more ideas than you're currently getting the chance to use.

Sound familiar?

As Digital Marketing & Growth Executive, you'll have the opportunity to do something about that.

You'll be joining a growing business in Shrewsbury that's already generating some brilliant traction through YouTube and Meta.
The content's there, the videos are there and the enquiries are coming in.

But there's so much more they could be doing with it!
Imagine looking at the manufacturing industry and spotting an opportunity in concrete production. Or realising there's a whole market of bakeries that could benefit from what the business offers.

You'll be the person who sees that opportunity, works out how to reach those businesses and gets the right campaigns in front of them.

And when the leads start coming in, you'll make sure they're getting to the people who can turn them into customers.

As Digital Marketing & Growth Executive you need to be someone who's got a bit of sales in them too.

Not someone who wants to spend their days cold calling

Someone who understands the commercial side of marketing, who gets excited about generating genuine business, not just likes and impressions.

You'll already know your way around Meta Ads Manager, advertising funnels, audience targeting and campaign performance, that's important because you'll need to get stuck in from day one.

But it's your personality that'll really make the difference.
You're curious.
You've got energy.
You ask questions.
You spot things other people miss.

Perhaps you're currently a Digital Marketing Executive who knows they're capable of more but hasn't been given the opportunity to prove it.

Well, here's your chance.
As Digital Marketing & Growth Executive, you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas, explore different markets and see what happens when the campaigns you're running actually turn into business.
It's initially a maternity cover contract, and you'll need to be available to start immediately.

But you'll be joining a growing business with plenty happening, where the experience you bring and the ideas you have will genuinely matter.
Up to £37,500, based in Shrewsbury.

So, if you're a Digital Marketing & Growth Executive who gets just as much satisfaction from a new customer enquiry as you do from a brilliantly performing campaign, perhaps it's time we had a conversation.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Based in the heart of Shropshire, our established and growing organisation delivers high-quality services and products to clients across the UK. We take pride in building lasting relationships, fostering a collaborative culture, and continuously refining how we engage with our audience. As our business continues to expand its reach, strengthening our brand presence and communicating our values through modern digital channels has never been more vital.

The Digital Marketing Executive role is pivotal to our commercial ambition. By taking ownership of our day-to-day digital activities, you will directly influence how prospects discover us, how customers interact with our services, and how our reputation flourishes online. You will work closely with colleagues across sales, operations, and creative teams to ensure our messaging is consistent, compelling, and aligned with our strategic goals.

Based in Shropshire, you will enjoy working in one of the country's most picturesque market towns, offering a vibrant independent food scene, historic architecture, and beautiful countryside right on your doorstep, making Shropshire an exceptional place to live and work.

Location: Shropshire

Salary: £29,000 - £32,500 per year

Employment: Permanent

The Role

As our Digital Marketing Executive, you will plan, execute, and optimise multi-channel campaigns that drive engagement, generate qualified leads, and raise brand awareness.
- Planning and executing multi-channel digital marketing campaigns across organic social media, email, and digital advertising.
- Managing our day-to-day social media presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and X, engaging proactively with our online community.
- Writing clear, persuasive, and search-optimised copy for our website, blog posts, case studies, and digital newsletters.
- Designing, building, and deploying targeted email marketing campaigns, including automated workflows, customer segmentation, and A/B testing.
- Overseeing on-page SEO activities, identifying keyword opportunities, and coordinating technical updates with external web developers.
- Monitoring, managing, and optimising paid search and paid social campaigns to maximise return on ad spend.
- Tracking website traffic, user journeys, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4, translating raw data into actionable commercial insights.
- Collaborating with internal teams to produce high-quality multimedia assets, including graphics, short-form video, and digital brochures.
- Conducting regular competitor analysis and industry benchmarking to keep our digital strategies fresh, relevant, and effective.

About You
- Proven experience in a digital marketing role, with demonstrable success in managing digital campaigns from concept to completion (essential).
- Exceptional written communication skills, with an eye for detail, accurate proofreading ability, and the flexibility to adapt tone for different audiences (essential).
- Practical familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and core digital reporting frameworks (essential).
- Hands-on experience working with email marketing platforms, automation tools, and content management systems such as WordPress (essential).
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, prioritise workloads, and remain calm under pressure (essential).
- Experience with digital design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva for producing visual assets (desirable).
- Working knowledge of PPC advertising, including Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager (desirable).
- A relevant degree or professional qualification in marketing, communications, or a related discipline (desirable).

A Typical Day

Your morning might begin with a review of key campaign analytics from the previous day, checking engagement metrics and tweaking active paid social adverts to improve performance. Mid-morning could see you drafting an insightful article for the company blog and scheduling accompanying social media posts, followed by a collaborative catch-up with the sales team to coordinate content for an upcoming campaign. After lunch, you might design an automated email workflow for new subscribers, review technical SEO recommendations, and spend an hour testing new graphic templates for an upcoming digital newsletter before planning your priorities for the rest of the week.

What You Can Expect
- A permanent role with a growing, ambitious Shropshire organisation dedicated to delivering excellence.
- 28 days annual leave including bank holidays.
- A structured training programme and genuine support to help you develop your career towards a marketing manager position.
- A friendly, inclusive, and collaborative working environment where your ideas and initiative are welcomed.
- Modern office facilities in Shropshire with complimentary refreshments and on-site parking.
- Access to a workplace pension scheme and regular team social events throughout the year.
- Dedicated personal development time to attend marketing webinars, workshops, and industry conferences.

If you are an ambitious marketer ready to take the next step in your career and make a tangible contribution to our continued growth, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your CV alongside a tailored cover letter explaining why your experience and skills align with this position.

title: Practice Marketing Assistant
description:
Practice Marketing Assistant
Salary: up to £26,000
Contract Type: 6 months Fixed term contract
Location: Hybrid working (office based in Oswestry) - typically 2 days in the office per week

Shape Brighter Futures with Practice Plan
At Practice Plan, part of the Wesleyan Group, we're passionate about supporting dental practices across the UK to grow and succeed. We pride ourselves on building strong relationships, delivering outstanding customer service and helping our clients achieve their ambitions.

Joining Practice Plan means becoming part of a friendly and collaborative team where your contribution matters. You'll have opportunities to learn, develop and grow your career while working in an organisation that values its people and celebrates success.

Make a Difference in a Marketing Assistant role
As a Marketing Assistant at Practice Plan, you will be responsible for the delivery of a range of marketing activities for our practices across a broad range of channels. You will own the full briefing process from conception through to production on behalf of our practices working closely with the Design team and Regional Support Managers to deliver and assist in building strong relationships.

Your Impact
Here's how you'll make a difference:
- Act as the conduit between the practice and the Design Team, create, then submit design briefs to our in-house design studio - providing them with a clear specification on literature to be designed for the practice and then continuing to work closely with the designers to meet both practice expectations and deadlines on all items.
- Support the practice with a full suite of marketing collateral to assist with the effective promotion of their membership plan.
- Support with the onboarding of new practices into the business handholding the practice through the process and understanding their onboarding marketing needs.
- Proof read all literature at various stages ensuring that factual accuracy, grammar and design consistency is of the highest standard. Circulate to relevant personnel at the appropriate time.
- Send final proofs of all literature to clients and acting on any feedback by making amendments to copy or design style when needed. Once approved, send literature to printers and liaise with the printers to confirm time scales for delivery.
- Obtain and send quotes to clients for chargeable design and print work - check and sign invoices.
- Answer calls into the Practice Marketing Team helping with any specific marketing, or general enquiries practices may have.
- Coordinate fee increase requests from practices and the fee increase system to update marketing literature by submitting design briefs to our in-house design studio - then continuing to work closely with the designers to meet both practice expectations and deadlines on all items.
- Assisting with admin tasks as required including preparing and sending in-house prints to practices, stationery requests plus any other ad hoc requests.

What You'll Bring
- Ability to translate client needs into detailed creative briefs
- A confident and clear communicator
- Excellent customer service skills with a natural ability to form strong client facing relationships
- Ability to prioritise workloads and work to deadlines
- Exceptional eye for detail
- Excellent administration skills
- Highly organised and methodical
- Works well under pressure
- Independent worker
- A natural problem solver and thinker
- Excellent standard of English both written and oral.
- Competent in IT including Microsoft Office.

Benefits That Work for You
We believe rewards should reflect the life you live. Here's what you can expect:
- 28 days holiday (plus a culture day!)
- Flexible hybrid working for better work-life balance.
- Company pension scheme - matched plus 2% (up to 10%).
- Enhanced family leave and two volunteering days to give back to causes you care about.

Why Practice Plan?
We're building a culture where everyone belongs. Diversity isn't just a policy-it's part of who we are. Whatever your background, we want you to feel valued and empowered to thrive.

We're proud supporters of the ABI Making Flexible Work campaign, which means we're open to discussing flexible working, job shares, and part-time options.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know-we're here to support you.

What to Know Before Applying
- Right to Work: We're unable to provide VISA sponsorship, so you'll need the legal right to live and work in the UK.
- Advert Closing: We typically advertise for two weeks but may close early if we receive a high volume of applications-apply early to avoid disappointment.
- Regulatory Requirements: As a financial services organisation, we adopt the highest standards. This role is subject to regulatory checks, including criminal record and credit checks, and ongoing assessments under the SMCR Framework.

Ready to Shape Your Future?
Apply today and join us in helping Practice Plan deliver reliable, secure technology that supports our colleagues, our customers and our future growth.

title: Social Media and Community Manager
description:
Social Media & Community Brand Manager

Market Drayton
Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week

About the Role

At Müller Yogurts & Desserts, we believe our brands should do more than show up in people's fridges. They should show up in conversations, communities and culture too.

We're looking for a Social Media & Community Brand Manager to bring our brands to life across social media, creating conversations people want to join and content they want to share.

Joining us as we grow our in-house social media capability, you'll play a key role in strengthening our social presence, building meaningful connections with consumers and helping our brands earn their place in culture.

This is a role for someone who genuinely loves social media. You'll enjoy spotting emerging trends, understanding what gets people talking and be just as excited by audience insights as you are by engaging content.

Working closely with our Social, Digital and Brand teams, alongside agency partners, you'll help shape how our brands show up across social media.

What You'll Be Doing
- Lead the day-to-day management of our organic social media channels, working with internal teams and agency partners.
- Work closely with the Brand teams and agency partners to brief, review and optimise social-first content.
- Identify opportunities for reactive and cultural content, helping our brands join conversations authentically.
- Champion the voice of Müller across our social channels, helping turn audiences into communities and followers into fans.
- Lead community management and social listening activity, helping consumers feel heard, valued and engaged.
- Turn conversations, comments and trends into useful audience insights that inform future content, campaigns and brand experiences.
- Monitor competitor activity and identify opportunities for our brands to differentiate and stand out.
- Track content, channel and campaign performance, using data and insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Work with agency and media partners to develop reporting, dashboards and clear, actionable recommendations.
- Bring a social-first perspective to campaigns, partnerships and wider brand plans, while keeping teams informed of emerging trends, platform developments and social best practice.

What We're Looking For

This role could be a great fit for someone from an agency background looking to move in-house, or an experienced Community Manager ready for greater ownership and influence.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong, demonstrable experience managing brands across social media, with particular experience in community management. Agency experience would be advantageous and FMCG experience beneficial.
- A strong understanding of platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn, alongside an interest in emerging channels.
- Strong knowledge of social media performance metrics and the ability to turn data into clear recommendations and actions.
- Experience using social listening, analytics and reporting tools. Knowledge of Brandwatch would be an advantage.
- Excellent written communication skills with the ability to adapt your style across different brands, audiences and platforms.
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with confidence working across internal teams and external partners.
- A genuine interest in culture, consumer behaviour and the trends that capture people's attention.

You'll be naturally curious about people, creative and comfortable using data to inform your decisions.

You'll also be collaborative, proactive and organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of social media at Müller and work with some of the UK's most recognised brands.

You'll help build our in-house social capability from the ground up, working alongside a passionate team of brand builders and agency partners to grow communities whose views, opinions and conversations can help influence what we do next.

If you love social media, enjoy understanding what makes communities tick and get a buzz from creating content and conversations that resonate, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits
- Competitive salary
- Bonus scheme of up to 10%
- 25 days' annual leave, increasing with service
- Option to buy and sell up to 5 days' annual leave
- Private medical healthcare
- Pension scheme
- Life assurance
